description:
At home he’s quiet and reserved but he cares for his wife and children more than anyone. At work he’s recognized as a responsible team leader. Yet the world calls him a “stubborn old man.” He values others’ opinions over his own happiness. That’s why Manager Kim obsesses over other people’s children, their cars and the houses they live in—more than his own life. Can Manager Kim, a big company employee who owns a home in Seoul, ever find true happiness?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*
